title: Competitor Health Index and Payload Compatibility Inventory
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Synthesize a repeatable Competitor Health Index (CHI) and a granular Payload Compatibility Inventory (PCI) across top-of-market open and hosted models. CHI will score vendors on availability, latency stability, model freshness, quantization/ft support, and enterprise features (SSO/KMS/RBAC). PCI catalogs accepted input shapes and deployment constraints (max context, streaming semantics, function/tool calling compatibility, tokenizer differences, max tokens, recommended batching strategies) so engineering and solutions teams can map customer workloads to fallback and procurement playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: CHI scoring rubric published with explicit metric definitions and weightings
PCI spreadsheet with at least 24 vendor-model rows and explicit columns for tokenization, max_context, streaming, function_calling, kv_cache_support, quantization_compatibility
Dashboard prototype in Looker/Metabase showing CHI over time and top incompatibility vectors
Runbook mapping 5 canonical customer payloads to recommended primary + 2 fallback models with cost/latency tradeoffs
Stakeholder review (Eng, Solutions, Sales) and sign-off recorded in Confluence

Avoid subjective model-quality judgements in this deliverable; link to Eval team for quality delta analysis. Expect follow-up sprint to add regional capacity metrics and reserved-capacity price anchors.
